pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: district wise 2023: ANC completed over registered and employed over enrolled as percentages from both tables
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: WITH anc AS (SELECT district, pregnancies_registered, anc4_completed FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023), livelihood AS (SELECT district, women_enrolled, employed_at_6_months FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023) SELECT anc.district, (anc.anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(anc.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0)) AS anc_completed_pct, (livelihood.employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(livelihood.women_enrolled, 0), 0)) AS employed_pct FROM anc JOIN livelihood USING (district)

district wise 2023: ANC completed over registered and employed over enrolled as percentages from both tables
attempts.response:
WITH anc AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    pregnancies_registered,
    anc4_completed
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE year = 2023
),
livelihood AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    women_enrolled,
    employed_at_6_months
  FROM livelihoods
  WHERE year = 2023
)
SELECT
  anc.district,
  (anc.anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(anc.pregnancies_registered, 0)) AS anc_completed_pct,
  (livelihood.employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(livelihood.women_enrolled, 0)) AS employed_pct
FROM anc
JOIN livelihood USING (district);
